description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications that handles common setup, particularly logging initialization, and serves as a superclass for other activity classes.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base class for activities that provides common setup for logging and extends FragmentActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created; currently only calls superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity becomes visible; initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging system using custom LogWrapper and Android's Log utility.
